tools.name: get_dns
tools.description: Get the console's current DNS configuration for the active network connection: whether it's automatic (DHCP) or manual, and the primary/secondary DNS server addresses.

tools.name: set_dns
tools.description: Set the active connection's DNS servers. Pass 'primary' (and optional 'secondary') as IPv4 strings to set manual DNS, or 'automatic':true to revert to DHCP. Useful for pointing the console at a custom/black-hole DNS (e.g. 90DNS) to block Nintendo servers while staying on the LAN.

automatic.description: true = revert to DHCP DNS (ignores primary/secondary).
